note: Re-judged 2026-11-06 by an independent auditor who authored none of the changes named; no test or record ran for this judgement. RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 (Idle): "In response to a ManualStart event (Event 1) or an AutomaticStart event (Event 3), the local system: - initializes all BGP resources for the peer connection, - sets ConnectRetryCounter to zero". runOnce changed in 1e65b6d4bb: its only hunk replaces the egressRouteFilter closure with p.egressGate(session), which touches neither cycleReachedEstablished, operatorStarted nor the start selection and moves that selection up two lines (peer_run.go:438 and :441). The tagged test files and fsm.go show no diff since the verdict's commit. Peer units read: exactly 0 once the next connection dials after an Established session, by Cease and by real HoldTimer expiry, and exactly 1 kept after a cycle that never reached Established, including one following an earlier Established cycle, so a start event fired on every cycle, on none, or from an uncleared flag goes red. The record file is retaken: mutants at lines 438 and 441 match the current source, and the runOnce whole-body revert proves reach only. Bound on question 4: the row also holds "initializes all BGP resources", which the RFC does not enumerate; no unit lists resources, and its only observation here is that the next cycle dials or accepts. Sibling RFC4271-8.2.2-7 judges the same clause for Event 1. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
